spans.s: (p.p. of √ वच्, q.v., उक्त॑, RV.), uttered, said, spoken
N. of a divine being (v.l. for उक्थ, q.v.), Hariv.
word, sentence, Śiś. &c.
nf. (अम्, आ) a stanza of four lines (with one syllabic instant or one long or two short syllables in each);
उक्त—त्व n. the being spoken or uttered, Sāh.
उक्त—निर्वाह m. maintaining an assertion.

उक्त—पुंस्क a (feminine or neuter) word of which also a masculine is mentioned or exists (and whose meaning only differs from that of the masculine by the notion of gender; e.g. the word गङ्गा is not उक्त-पुंस्क, whereas such words as शुभ्र and ग्राम-णी are so; cf. भाषित-पुंस्क), Vop. iv, 8.
उक्त—पूर्व mfn. spoken before or formerly, MBh.
उक्त—प्रत्युक्त॑ n. speech and reply, discourse, conversation, ŚBr. xi, 5, 1, 10
a kind of anthem or alternate song, Sāh.
उक्त॑—भाव mfn. having the sense already expressed, Hāla, Sch.
merely uttered, MBh.
उक्त॑—र्षि (for -ऋषि), m. the Ṛṣi mentioned, Anukr.
उक्त—वत् mfn. one who has spoken (see √ वच्).
उक्त—वर्जम् ind. except the cases mentioned.
उक्त—वाक्य mfn. one who has given an opinion, R.
उक्त—वाक्य n. a dictum, decree, L.
spoken and not spoken.
one who has received an order, ŚBr. xiv, 7, 3, 25.
उक्—˚तार्थ mfn. (= -भाव above), Vām.
one who has been taught the Upaniṣads, ŚBr. xiv, 6, 11, 1.
any brief or compendious phrase or description.
sentence, proclamation, speech, expression, word, Mn.; Pañcat.; Kathās. &c.
a worthy speech or word, BhP.
उक्ति—पोष m. a pleonastic expression, Mālatīm., Sch.
उक्ति—प्रत्युक्तिका f. speech and answer, Mcar.
ind.p. having spoken or said (see √ वच्).
